purpose: Resolve concrete build and clipboard-reporting defects from the g459 review without claiming the intermittent input recovery failure is fixed.

sourceChanges.toolchain: CI and release select the exact reviewed runtime manifest toolchain. Stable patch promotion updates the reviewed backport manifest and go.mod together; the exception ends with removal of the temporary backport.
sourceChanges.clipboard: Native text/image preparation and application failures reach local API, authorized transfer status and the UI. Report formats match payload wire formats: empty text, png, dib and files. Application reports still require the current peer, incoming ID and exact format. No clipboard contents, paths or native error strings are projected to the UI.
sourceChanges.limits: Existing 64KiB text, 40MiB image and 64MiB file limits are unchanged. Image pixel-limit violations remain a bounded generic preparation failure.

localTraceInspection.profileMethod: go tool trace -pprof=sched, -pprof=syscall and -pprof=sync; go tool pprof -top; parsed RangeBegin/RangeEnd events matched by range name and scope.
localTraceInspection.interpretation: The recorded resident-agent interval has sub-millisecond GC stop-the-world ranges. Scheduler and blocking profiles aggregate goroutines; their totals are not an individual handoff or end-to-end latency.
localTraceInspection.correlationLimit: This trace ends before the 2026-10-25T12:41:19Z baseline cutoff of the 13 g459 crossings. Its generation is not established. It cannot explain or disprove the later 324277us capture activation, a separate worker's native call delay, or the intermittent recovery failure. No runtime policy, safety timeout or authorization was relaxed based on it.
localTraceInspection.privacy: Raw trace, parsed events and profiles remain local ignored artifacts; only bounded observations and the trace hash are recorded here.
